model.name: LES Visitor & Culture Hub

site.location: Allen Street Malls, between Delancey St and Rivington St, Manhattan (Block 415, Lot 150)
site.owner: NYC Department of Parks and Recreation

procurement.typical_fee_structure: greater of guaranteed minimum annual fee vs. percentage of gross receipts, ~5% annual escalation
procurement.security_deposit: 25% of highest year's guaranteed minimum fee
procurement.fee_terms_for_this_rfp: unknown - obtain RFP document from NYC Parks / PASSPort

model.thesis: Earn revenue by routing visitors to neighborhood cultural groups and businesses rather than competing with them.

revenue_streams.description: Sell tours, tickets and classes for all partner organizations, and lodging at member hotels; LESCC earns a commission on each sale.
partners_served: member hotels (e.g., Nine Orchard / MML Hospitality)

hotel_partnership.two_way_referral: Hotel concierges sell hub tours and programs to guests; the hub refers visitors, visiting artists and partner guests to member hotels for a commission

revenue_streams.description: Consignment sales of work by local artists and makers, plus partner merchandise.
A different partner group runs the front room each month as a pop-up; LESCC takes a revenue share.
Neighborhood cafes and bakeries rotate through the food counter instead of LESCC operating its own cafe. Formal basis for RFP food-service compliance.
Small performances, readings and private events.

public_amenity.restrooms: Open to the public on published hours, operated and maintained by LESCC

value_to_parks.cash: Guaranteed minimum annual fee plus percentage of gross across all streams
value_to_parks.risk_reduction: Fee backed by coalition pledges; food-only model has stalled since the 2016 RFP

value_capture_mechanism.short_term: Coalition fee-guarantee fund: area businesses and property owners pledge to guarantee Parks' minimum fee and security deposit
value_capture_mechanism.backstop: Lower East Side BID (mandatory assessment; covers Allen St between Houston and Canal)
value_capture_mechanism.long_term: Park Improvement District pilot (proposed citywide, not yet established)

data_loop.reporting: Annual uplift report to coalition members and Parks

compliance_risk.issue: RFP is for a food service concession; a hub without food may be non-responsive.
compliance_risk.mitigation: Make the rotating food counter the formal concession, with the hub built around it.
compliance_risk.verify_with: Ian McDermott (NYS procurement & administrative regulations, Community Advisory Team)

sources.food_businesses: NYC Open Data - DOHMH Restaurant Inspection Results (43nn-pn8j), active = inspected since 2024-11-01
sources.cultural_orgs: NYC Open Data - DCLA Cultural Organizations (u35m-9t32)
sources.noise: NYC Open Data - 311 Service Requests (erm2-nwe9), Nov 2023 to Nov 2026
sources.demographics: US Census ACS 2020-2024 5-year, via Census Reporter; rings built from whole census tracts

restrooms.site_status: Listed as 'Allen Street Malls - Not Operational'

coalition_gaps: Park-facing ground-floor businesses (none on current Community Advisory Team)
Chinese community representation (36% of residents within 400m; none on team)
Food vendors (current opposition; convert to rotating food partners)
